summary: First-iteration full-stack review of the PMC Managers Tender Management app. 30 backend pytest cases (auth, vendor lifecycle, tenders, bids, uploads, admin, notifications) — 30/30 PASSED. Frontend Playwright coverage of landing, register, vendor profile 6-step stepper, admin/vendors, notifications, buyer create-tender — all critical selectors and navigations work. No blocking issues.

minor.issue: Vendor sees ALL tenders (open/closed/awarded), no filter to only open. The inline comment ('vendors only see open tenders') is not enforced in code — the branch is a pass.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' is defined in .env but ignored by server.py (uses FRONTEND_URL directly). Dead env var — remove or wire it up.
Sets auth cookies immediately after signup. Fine for UX, but no email verification — acceptable per PRD.

issues: Uses native browser datetime-local picker for 'Submission deadline' instead of a shadcn Calendar/DatePicker. Inconsistent with rest of the design language.

Task spec expected data-testids named vp-step-1..vp-step-6 but implementation uses vendor-step-1..vendor-step-6. Functionally identical but the naming diverges from the review request — align if strict.
'Next step' button is unconditional — it never validates required fields on the current step, so a user can walk to step 6 empty and only find out on submit. Consider per-step required validation.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Enforce open-only tender filter for vendor role in GET /api/tenders.
(Nice-to-have) Replace native datetime input on CreateTender with shadcn calendar/date-time picker.
(Optional) Rename vendor-step-N testids to vp-step-N to match spec, or update spec to match code.
(Optional) Per-step field validation in VendorProfile so 'Next' cannot skip incomplete required fields.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 630 lines and contains ALL routes, models, seeds and helpers in one file — split into routers/auth.py, routers/vendors.py, routers/tenders.py, routers/bids.py plus a models.py and seed.py once it grows further.
list_bids branch when mine=true and user.role == 'buyer' incorrectly sets q['vendor_id']=None (line ~477) — dead branch but confusing; also duplicated computation with the tender_id list path.
list_tenders vendor branch is a no-op — either remove the comment or actually restrict to open tenders.
seed_admin_and_demo does NOT reseed buyer/vendor passwords if changed via env (only admin gets password sync). Minor.
Auth cookies set with secure=False — acceptable for preview but must be secure=True in production; add a config toggle.
No refresh-token endpoint despite issuing refresh_token cookie — token silently dies after 24h forcing re-login. Add POST /api/auth/refresh or drop the refresh cookie.
test_credentials: Admin admin@pmcmanagers.com/Admin@123, Buyer buyer@pmcmanagers.com/Buyer@123, Vendor(pending) vendor@example.com/Vendor@123. Also created TEST_vendor_*/TEST_buyer_* accounts during runs.
seed_data_creation: backend_test.py registers throwaway TEST_-prefixed vendor + buyer accounts on each run (no cleanup — safe due to prefix). Also created one approved vendor + one open→awarded tender + one awarded bid + associated notifications during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend suite with: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0` — MUST pass -n 0 because pytest.ini forces xdist parallelism which breaks the shared CTX dict across workers. Front-end vendor profile testids are `vendor-step-N` NOT `vp-step-N`. Tender status flow verified end-to-end (open→awarded). Vendor `vendor@example.com` is intentionally left in pending state (test relies on this).
